title: scaevola albida var. pallida
intro: Scaevola albida var. pallida, commonly known as the pale fan flower, is a flowering plant native to Australia, known for its delicate white flowers with five petals. The pale fan flower has been used in traditional medicine, providing various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Scaevola albida var. pallida include soothing skin irritations, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory issues, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
